name: North Face
approach: The standard access to Golden Horn's north side starts from the Rainy Pass PCT North trailhead on Hwy 20, following the PCT north over Cutthroat and Granite Passes and up the signed spur to Snowy Lakes (~6,700 ft); a rougher, off-trail alternative bushwhacks up Swamp Creek from a highway pullout about 3 miles before Rainy Pass. From Snowy Lakes, travel northwest toward Golden Horn's basin to access the north aspect; this is the general basin-access line reported by parties, not pitch-by-pitch beta for the original 1958 North Face route.
